messages:
maria: Heads-up — prefix-cache hit-rate for model redwood-13b:opt-v3 dropped ~92% -> ~58% after the kernel-scheduler/attn-hybrid rollout yesterday. P50 gen latency up ~12%. Anyone seen this?
perf-bot: Deploy detected: compiler:attn-hybrid v2 -> v3; rollout @akshay at 2025-11-02T03:12Z. Auto telemetry flagged prefix_cache_hit drop to 0.58 (alert).
akshay: I kicked that rollout. We changed the kernel preference to prefer fused_attn_v3 for seq<=128. Quick note: fused_attn_v3 touches the KV key path for perf reasons (skips some canonicalization) — could be relevant.
sasha: Can you paste an example cache key (redact hashes)? I want to see ordering of meta fields.
maria: sample (redacted): `prefix_key=md5:4f3a9b2e...; kv_meta=seq:64|build:20251101|quant:4bit`
After v3 we see keys like `kv_meta=build:20251101|seq:64|quant:4bit` — looks like ordering changed.
ryan: That matches a canonicalization gap hypothesis. Runtime v1 forced a deterministic order before hashing; fused_attn_v3's fast path bypasses the canonicalizer causing mismatched hashes -> consistent misses.
akshay: Repro in staging: run `wrk -t8 -c200 --prefix-warmup warm_prompts.json` 5k requests. Before kernel swap: prefix_hit_rate=0.91. After swap: prefix_hit_rate=0.59. Also noticed batching behavior changes: batcher groups by kernel_variant now, which fragments warmup traffic.
sasha: I ran a quick flame profile and the KV lookup path looks different. Snippet: 
```
KV lookup (pre): 0.8ms per lookup
KV lookup (post): 2.6ms per lookup (more fallthroughs)
Kernel selection overhead: 3.1% -> 9.7% CPU
Disk/IO time increased due to more misses
```
Seems the miss path is dominant now.
maria: Can we do a short mitigation — force older kernel for models with prefix cache or re-enable canonicalization?
akshay: Patch ready: (A) re-enable canonicalization in the kernel-selection shim, (B) runtime flag `--force-kernel=fused_attn_v2` to use pre-rollout variant. I'll push hotfix to dedicated hosts and run a 5% canary. Also prepping an integration test.
ryan: Proposed rollout plan: 1) Hotfix canonicalizer + unit tests 2) Canary force-kernel at 5% -> monitor prefix_hit and latency 3) If stable, 25% -> 100% 4) Add CI guard to ensure canonical cache key parity across kernel variants. Also change batching heuristics: avoid grouping by kernel_variant for warmup prefixes.
sasha: Another improvement: add debug header `X-prefix-salt` and a short debug-mode log for key canonical form so we can triage future key mismatches quickly.
maria: I'll open an ops ticket and add the prompt sets we used for the regression test. Can someone create the postmortem and link the canary runs?
perf-bot: Created ticket INF-2981: "prefix-cache-key-mismatch-after-kernel-scheduler-v3" assigned to akshay, sasha. Severity: P2.
akshay: Starting hotfix rollout now (pushing runtime v2025.11.03-canonicalizer). Will report when 5% canary completes.
maria: :thumbsup:
ryan: After hotfix, we should also consider a policy change: block kernel variant auto-swap on models with prefix_cache enabled until they've passed a warmup validation job.
